blurb: Daytona Golf Club offers an 18-hole golf course with walking and riding options, indoor sports courts for tennis, pickleball, racquetball, and wallyball, and banquet facilities for events. They provide leagues for various groups and a golf simulator experience. The club has been operating since 1964 and emphasizes a friendly atmosphere for guests.
